Who We Are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges.

We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap.

You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.

Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Data products (data pipelines/export, revenue and reconciliation reporting, and analytics tooling) to accelerate opportunities
Demonstrate a deep understanding of how businesses warehouse and model payments and revenue data — data pipelines into Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, and Databricks; ETL/ELT patterns; and how that data feeds financial reporting, reconciliation, and BI
Conduct deep discovery of customers' existing data architecture, warehouse, and reporting stack to architect solutions that align Stripe's Data capabilities with their analytics and finance requirements
Advise customers on how to design for complexity: multi-entity and multi-currency reporting, custom data models, integration with existing BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Sigma, Metabase) and ERP/GL systems, and data freshness/latency requirements
Create and share best practices and reusable assets such as reference architectures to enhance the quality and efficiency of the broader sales and pre-sales organizations
Partner closely with the Data product sales team and actively drive opportunities for Stripe's largest customers, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" to drive product and feature request prioritization
Identify product, industry, implementation, and competitive trends, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales to influence Stripe's Data product roadmap
Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
Represent the technical health of the business on quarterly sales forecast calls and highlight deal blockers with proposed solutions
Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

You're capable of engaging in both business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of a customer organization, including finance, data, and engineering leadership. You enjoy working on products that require deep technical understanding combined with business context, and you're as comfortable in a warehouse schema as you are in a revenue conversation with a CFO. You're excited to become an expert and to share that knowledge broadly.
If you meet the minimum requirements below, we encourage you to apply — the preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

7+ years of experience in a technical sales, pre-sales, or solutions architecture role, with a focus on data platforms, analytics, or financial reporting
3+ years of hands-on experience with data warehousing and pipeline architecture (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks) and ETL/ELT tooling
Strong understanding of how payments and revenue data maps to financial reporting and reconciliation workflows
Experience working with or implementing BI/analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Sigma, Metabase, or similar)
Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns, including how data pipelines are built and maintained
Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into data pipelines or web applications
Familiarity with complex reporting scenarios: multi-entity consolidation, revenue recognition data models, or usage-based billing data
Experience with SQL at an advanced level and comfort working directly in a customer's data warehouse during discovery
Experience as a subject matter expert in financial services, fintech, or a data/analytics vertical
Pre-sales experience with Enterprise customers

The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact.

We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption.

The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
Within Education, we partner with universities, schools, research institutions, and countrywide education systems to advance responsible, mission-aligned uses of AI. These environments require more than technical deployment: success depends on institutional trust, thoughtful governance, stakeholder education, change management, and a value narrative that resonates with academic leaders, researchers, IT teams, faculty, administrators, and students.

As an Applied AI Architect for Education, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of education customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business,” shaping each institution’s AI strategy and guiding its journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable institutional impact.
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Edu, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate institutional priorities into a focused portfolio of use cases, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable value and growth. The Account Director owns the commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
You will work across academic, research, administrative, and operational contexts—helping customers determine where AI can responsibly improve teaching and learning, accelerate research, strengthen student and faculty services, and make institutional operations more effective.

You will account for the realities of education environments, including shared governance, complex stakeholder networks, academic calendars, accessibility, data privacy, responsible-AI expectations, and the need to build confidence among communities with differing levels of AI readiness.
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, education programs, and partners. This role calls for strong education-sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy, academic and operational workflows, and hands-on technical conversations.

Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing education customers and pre-sales prospects.
Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, value-realization path, and expansion opportunities.
Lead discovery with institutional executives, academic leaders, researchers, faculty, administrators, and technical teams to identify and prioritize use cases connected to meaningful institutional objectives.
Translate education priorities into clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, institutional data, identity, integrations, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
Guide institutions through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its responsible path to production.
Translate institutional objectives into actionable adoption roadmaps with clear workstreams, sequencing, milestones, stakeholder ownership, governance, risks, success measures, and change-management needs.
Develop a focused use-case portfolio across areas such as teaching and learning, research, student and faculty services, knowledge management, software development, and administrative operations.
Translate institutional objectives into actionable adoption roadmaps with clear workstreams, sequencing, milestones, stakeholder ownership, governance, risks, success measures, and change-management needs.
Build trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, provosts, deans, research leaders, faculty, administrators, and other institutional stakeholders.
Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, Product, Research, education specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
Identify repeatable education patterns and reusable architectures that can accelerate responsible adoption across institutions, departments, campuses, and education systems.
Translate field insights into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, and Research, representing the needs and production patterns of education customers.
Help identify expansion opportunities where OpenAI can support additional academic, research, administrative, or operational workflows.

s.h: You might thrive in this role if you
s.t:
Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable value realization.
Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
Can translate technical capabilities into institutional value across priorities such as student success, research productivity, faculty enablement, administrative effectiveness, accessibility, risk, and governance.
Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity, competing stakeholder needs, and complex technical choices into a practical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping education institutions deploy advanced AI safely, responsibly, and in service of their missions.

You will be part of the Customer Excellence Group (CEG). Our purpose is to accelerate platform adoption and improve customer outcomes.

We do this through a portfolio of services, delivered by outstanding consultants, using our ecosystem of partners, our leading practices, methodologies and tools based on our experiences from 1000's of customer engagements. We help our customers realize value faster and reduce risks.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
The Platform Architect is a strategic technical leader responsible for helping our customers architect, mature, and governing scalable, secure, high-performing solutions on the ServiceNow platform. You will have the opportunity to shape the transformation for leading global financial institutions and work with the latest in AI advancements.

Platform Architects ensure customers use leading practices around instance strategy, technical governance, core data, integrations and the technical health of the platform. This is a consultative role.

Platform Architects work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners to align platform capabilities with business objectives, adopt best practices, and drive AI and digital transformation initiatives. They:
· Develop relationships with customer executives, platform owners, architects, and development teams help them understand the role of ServiceNow in their transformation vision.
· Guide customers in the architecture of end-to-end ServiceNow solutions across multiple modules such as ITSM, CMDB/CSDM, ITOM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, CSM, and Creator Workflows.
· Translate goals and desired into an architectural roadmap.
· Engage with the customer's Enterprise Architects to position ServiceNow as the digital transformation platform standard, integrated with their core applications.
· Ensure instance health by working to reduce technical debt and align to ServiceNow leading practices.
· Be an active contributor of leading practices and expertise related to the ServiceNow platform.
· Maintain the skills and certifications that are relevant to your customers and your role.
· Mentor others in their professional development.
· Evaluate and recommend new ServiceNow capabilities, including AI, agentic automation, and LLM integrations.
· Help customers adhere to ServiceNow architecture guardrails and coding standards.
· Contribute to platform innovation by identifying opportunities to improve user experience, reduce complexity, and increase automation.
· Support the development of reusable solutions, accelerators, and technical assets.
· Present platform strategy and design decisions to stakeholders and leadership

s.t:
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
10+ years progressive experience as part of a professional services organization and/or ServiceNow platform team, or equivalent experience
Experience in operational and/or implementation leadership roles on a large-scale ServiceNow deployment
Experience working with functional business leaders to identify business objectives and develop outcome-focused roadmaps
3+ years in an Enterprise or Solution Architect role, or relevant experience
Knowledge of data modeling, CMDB design, data strategies, platform security, and integration.
Cloud application technology experience
Familiarity with Enterprise Platforms in addition to ServiceNow
A strong customer focus
The ability to thrive in complexity
A strategic and collaborative mindset
Excellent presentation and communication skills
Strong executive communication skills
Ability to travel up to 50% of the time

Industry experience in Manufacturing preferrerd
Experience with agentic AI capabilities (e.g., LLM orchestration, generative workflows, Now Assist)
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, and Automated Testing Framework (ATF)
Certified Master Architect (CMA) or Certified Technical Architect (CTA) in good standing, or the willingness to obtain one of those certifications.
For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $148,900 - $232,600 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure.

Unlock Your Potential at Eaton : Where Diversity Drives Innovation. At Eaton , we believe diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds drive innovation and success. We're committed to empowering people and creating a brighter, more sustainable future.

Eaton 's Global Data Center Segment is one of the company's fastest-growing and most strategic businesses, helping power the digital economy. As cloud computing, AI, and high-density compute environments continue to accelerate, data centers face increasing demands for performance, resiliency, sustainability, and speed-to-market.

Leveraging a broad portfolio of power, cooling, software, services, and infrastructure solutions, Eaton helps customers deploy scalable, integrated data center architectures that meet today's needs while preparing for the future. Position Summary Eaton is seeking a Senior Systems Architect – IT Module to join the Data Center Architecture Team .

This senior technical leadership role will define and drive the architecture of the data center IT Module (white space) , including high-density power distribution, cooling integration, rack infrastructure, modular deployment strategies, and pod-level system design.

The position serves as the primary systems integrator across white space components, ensuring scalable, repeatable, and optimized designs that enable rapid deployment of compute capacity for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and next-generation AI data centers.

As a key member of the Data Center Architecture Team, you will help develop end-to-end reference architectures and collaborate directly with customers to shape future data center solutions.

Be knowledgeable of current trends and innovate the market. Identify and build positive relationships with all account decision-makers and influencers who impact current or future business with Eaton . Gain an in-depth understanding of the client development and buying process and be able to articulate it effectively.

Perform VoC by understanding and capturing clients' challenges and requirements and resolve them by co-designing to help evolving Eaton 's portfolio. Ensure an effective handover to Global Product Lines and Business Units so that they develop the right portfolio to respond to large customers’ requirements.

Support the application engineers in charge of key accounts in implementing your designs for specific customers. Maintain oversight of all advanced engineering-related engagements to ensure customer success and satisfaction, as well as Eaton 's performance as a vendor.

Be highly knowledgeable about the client's business, commercial condition, structure, strategy, operations, and challenges. Articulate this knowledge in terms of opportunity, growth, and risk with respect to Eaton 's business. Be highly knowledgeable about Eaton 's products, services, general business, structure, strategy, and operations.

Articulate this knowledge in terms of value to the client's business. Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting your proposed architecture within the Eaton organization. Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting Eaton within the client engineering organization.

Collaborate effectively with other sales and stakeholders at the function, country, region, and global levels. Provide and gain support so others can meet their responsibilities to the account.

Provide all internal stakeholders and functional departments with the account-specific guidance and insights required to execute their roles and add value to the client. Build a multi-lane bridge between Eaton and the client organization.

This may include GPL leaders, Engineering leaders, Product line managers, BU Engineers, BDM, Marketing, PMO, Services, Sales Operations & Order Management, Supply Chain, Leadership & Executive Management. Work with the Segment Marketing team to create white papers and other technical material to promote our designs and value proposition.
Leadership & experience: 15+ years in critical power system design and electrical distribution engineering (advanced degree strongly preferred).

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent recognized qualification Minimum of 10 years of related experience in the data center business across core domains of whitespace, cooling, power, fiber, controls, and rack systems
Masters degree in engineering or technical discipline

Has led multiple complex programs delivering medium- and low-voltage power architectures for large data centers or similar mission-critical facilities, spanning from medium-voltage (e.g. 15–35 kV) substation design to high-current low-voltage and ~1500 V direct-current systems.

Experience includes end-to-end oversight from conceptual architecture through deployment, with a record of on-time, reliable power system commissioning at multi-megawatt scale. Technical expertise: Expert in power conversion architectures for data centers, including MV AC distribution, LV AC, and high-voltage DC networks.

Mastery of protective coordination, converter and switchgear integration, busway and panelboard systems, large-scale UPS and energy storage, and DC power protection schemes.

Keeps abreast of emerging 380 → 800 V DC standards and cutting-edge power electronics (e.g. new 800 VDC components) and is a recognized innovator (patents or contributions to industry standards such as OCP open DC architectures or IEC committees on data center power).

Systems & architecture skills: Thinks at system level beyond the white space – ensures the IT Module design aligns with upstream power (Block 2) and facility cooling systems (Block 4) for a cohesive data center architecture.

Provides direction across multiple product and engineering teams (racks, busbars, cooling, monitoring, etc.) to develop standardized, integrated solutions. Mentors multi-disciplinary engineers and champions a shift from traditional, labor-intensive buildouts to automated, modular deployment approaches that improve speed-to-market and reliability.

Leadership & communication: Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive leadership and initiative, with experience guiding cross-functional teams or projects.

Demonstrated mentoring ability and influence in a matrixed organization, helping train and direct other engineers. Customer focus: Strong customer engagement skills – experience interacting with enterprise or hyperscale data center customers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that address their challenges.

Ability to incorporate Voice of Customer feedback into technical designs and roadmaps.
Technical knowledge in data centers design and construction, specifically POD-level architecture and modular design, high-density compute environments (AI/ML workloads) and/or liquid cooling architectures Project Management Experience: Experience with Product Design or Product Management with a working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall.

Additionally, function in a research and development function Strong customer-facing technical engagement experience

We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to support the integration of Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. In this role, you will work at the boundary between Wayve’s core AI Driver architecture and OEM / Tier 1 vehicle systems.

You will help define how Wayve software interfaces with vehicle platforms, including sensors, vehicle signals, middleware, ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging, and validation.

The ideal candidate can translate product and customer needs into clear technical specifications, understand both high-level system architecture and implementation details, and help ensure that Wayve’s solution integrates safely, efficiently, and consistently across customer programs.

You will be expected to work independently within your scope, handle ambiguous technical problems, identify dependencies and risks, and keep stakeholders aligned.

Define and manage the technical architecture for customer vehicle integration, focusing on the interface between Wayve software and OEM / Tier 1 vehicle systems.
Collaborate with Product Management to translate product requirements and customer program needs into actionable technical specifications.
Define and document integration boundaries with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined, or out of scope.
Translate ambiguous customer or partner discussions into explicit ownership boundaries, interface contracts, assumptions, dependencies, and open technical decisions.
Work closely with Software Architects to assess technical feasibility and ensure customer program integration needs are aligned with Wayve’s core architecture.
Coordinate with Validation Engineers to define integration test requirements and ensure customer program requirements are verifiable.
Develop and maintain program-facing technical documentation, including interface specifications, integration guides, ownership boundary definitions, architecture diagrams, and decision records.
Support customer program planning by identifying integration complexity, dependencies, technical gaps, technical risks, and required partner deliverables.
Participate in OEM and Tier 1 technical discussions, representing Wayve’s product architecture, integration approach, and technical assumptions.
Act as a technical bridge between customer programs and Wayve internal teams, ensuring customer-specific integration needs are clearly understood without unnecessarily fragmenting the core product architecture.

Essential
System & SW architecture expertise: Experience defining or contributing to technical architecture for ADAS, autonomous driving, embedded software, or vehicle systems, especially at the software–vehicle interface.
Product Boundary definition: Ability to define clear technical boundaries, ownership models, assumptions, dependencies, and interface contracts between internal software and external vehicle systems.
Vehicle and embedded software understanding: Good understanding of vehicle electronics, embedded software constraints, ECU integration, real-time execution, timing, diagnostics, and production vehicle software environments.
Automotive communication and E/E architecture: Knowledge of automotive communication protocols and architectures, such as CAN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, AUTOSAR, or equivalent.
OEM integration experience : Experience working with, or integrating systems for, automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers. Ability to support discussions on OEM-specific requirements, standards, and integration constraints.

Cross-functional multidisciplinary experience: Proven ability to work effectively across Product, Software Architecture, Hardware, Calibrations, System Safety, Validation, and customer-facing teams, including Field Application Engineering. Experience should span unit-level, subsystem-level, and system-level discussions, with the ability to align technical decisions across engineering domains and translate customer or product needs into practical architectural solutions.
Technical communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architecture topics clearly through documents, diagrams, and technical reviews.
Desirable

Experience working as a Tier 1 supplier in the automotive industry
Knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, and transformer architectures
Familiarity with end-to-end approaches in autonomous driving
Experience with automotive OEM integration projects
Hands-on experience with embedded Linux, QNX, Adaptive AUTOSAR, DDS, SOME/IP, or custom automotive middleware.
Experience with sensor integration, including cameras, radar, IMU, GNSS, calibration, timestamping, and synchronization.

About Thrivo
The independent wealth management industry is at an inflection point. AI, regulatory pressure, and a looming succession wave will determine which firms thrive — and which flounder — in the coming decade.
Thrivo Wealth Partners AG is a Swiss holding company based in Zug. Our model: partnering with founder-led independent wealth managers across the DACH region, helping them scale — organically and non-organically — and providing shared technology infrastructure. We are the long-term partner for future-ready wealth managers.

Christopher Kraft has accompanied numerous IWM transitions as an investment banker at Perella Weinberg Partners and in leading European wealth platforms. Felix Lobkowicz is a repeat founder — five companies, one IPO — and leads product and technology at Thrivo.

Finn Weise leads capital and governance with over a decade of experience building fintechs and financial platforms, previously at Morgan Stanley and European VC funds. On the board: Sebastian Henrichs, former CEO of FNZ Bank Germany — the leading wealth platform in the industry.
Behind Thrivo
Thrivo is backed by a circle of investors from the finance and fintech world — experienced operators, entrepreneurs, and family offices who understand this market and think long-term. A platform that promises long-term thinking to founders cannot itself be optimising for short-term returns.
The wealth management market in Germany and Switzerland is digitising — more slowly than other sectors, but with real momentum now. Thrivo is building the technology infrastructure that underpins this transformation: a platform for founder-led wealth managers that deploys compliance automation, AI-assisted processes, and modern data architecture in a way that until now has only been available to large institutions.
ThrivoOS is not another fintech dashboard. It is the operating system for a growing group of partner firms collectively managing several billion AUM. You build this — as the first technical full-time hire and the engineering lead.

You own the technical leadership of ThrivoOS. You set the architecture, coordinate the freelance senior engineer, and are the engineering constant in a project that bridges complex regulatory requirements — MiFID II, WpHG, BaFin — with modern AI infrastructure.
You work directly with Felix Lobkowicz (CTO-in-function) on product vision and technical direction. The most important architectural decisions are yours. The architecture and stack have not been finalised — you will define them together with Felix and Tech advisors based on your experience and what is right for the platform.
This is one of the few roles in DACH fintech where technical depth, genuine entrepreneurial ownership, and real equity participation come together.
What you own
Architecture & Infrastructure
· Design and build an event-sourced backend architecture — the structural foundation for regulatory-grade auditability under MiFID II and BaFin requirements
· Multi-tenant data architecture: one platform, many partner firms, strict data isolation and RBAC

· AI integration: automated meeting briefings, Gesprächsprotokoll generation, and document assembly for advisors via Gemini/RAG pipeline
· Compliance infrastructure: PII anonymisation before any LLM call, encryption at rest, consent management — structural, not bolt-on
Team & culture
· Coordinate the freelance senior full-stack engineer: architectural decisions, code quality, mutual peer review
· Technical point of contact for the product advisor and design partner advisors during pilot deployment
· Set the engineering culture from day one — we use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) as standard. We cover the cost.

Real equity participation

Provectus is a consulting and professional services firm with a focus on AI/ML based solutions. Provectus is an AWS Premier Partner and an Anthropic partner, helping enterprise clients move from AI experimentation to AI running in production.
We are changing how we deliver. Instead of handing a client a design and waiting for someone else to build it, our engineers embed directly inside the client's team and ship the system themselves. We call this Forward Deployed delivery. Before you design anything, you spend real time with the people who do the work the system is meant to change, so the architecture reflects how the work actually happens, not how a requirements document described it.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer or Solutions Architect with deep Python and Generative AI experience who wants to work this way: deep in the code, close to the client, and directly accountable for whether the system gets used. Direct client communication sits at the center of this role. Prior presales experience is a strong plus.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic trains and serves frontier AI models on some of the largest and most diverse accelerator fleets in the world, and the hardware those models run on is one of the most direct levers we have on capability, cost, and reliability. Our Hardware Systems team owns the system-level architecture of that compute — from the package boundary out through boards, racks, interconnect, power, cooling, and the datacenter interface.
We're hiring senior hardware systems architects and technical leads who can work broadly across the hardware stack and go deep where it's needed, and who have the judgment to make and own directional calls — what to build, what to buy, what to co-design with a partner. You'll set architecture, write the specs that partners and internal teams build against, and own the validation and qualification strategy that proves the result.
The skillsets we need span power, cooling, mechanical, interconnect, signal integrity, data and control plane, system management, reliability and serviceability — applied across networking, compute, storage, and accelerator systems.
You'll work closely with our ML performance, infrastructure software, supply chain, and datacenter teams, and directly with hardware vendors and partners across the stack. And because this is Anthropic, you'll have Claude as a genuine collaborator — we expect this team to push on what AI-assisted hardware design and review can look like.

Own system path-finding and architecture for your domain across the breadth of compute Anthropic deploys — from concept and requirements through spec, design review, and deployment — and act as a reviewer and thought partner across the others.
Write and own high-level requirements and specifications — system, board, interface, rack — that partners and internal teams build against.
Review partner and vendor designs against our requirements, make the build / buy / co-design calls with supply chain and partnership teams, and surface misalignment or schedule risk early enough to act on it.
Drive the interconnect and networking architecture that ties our systems together — scale-up and scale-out fabrics, NICs and switches, optics, and topology.
Drive board-, chassis-, and system-level architecture with our partners — major component placement, PCB architecture, connector and cable design, and power and thermal budgeting — at the chassis, rack, and data-hall level.
Develop performance simulations, hardware models, and "what-if" scenarios to evaluate and choose between candidate hardware architectures.
Define validation, bring-up, and qualification strategy for new platforms — including the telemetry and reliability targets they need to hit in the fleet — and track the technology roadmaps and vendor landscape that shape what we deploy in the short and long term.
Partner with ML performance and infrastructure software teams so hardware decisions land well for the workloads that actually run on them.
Help shape how hardware engineering operates at Anthropic — develop and apply AI-assisted approaches to design, spec review, and validation; establish review forums, spec standards, and partner engagement.

Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one core hardware-systems domain (e.g., interconnect, power, thermal) for large-scale compute or networking systems.
Experience owning hardware system architecture at scale — machine, rack, row, and cluster — and authoring specifications and requirements.
Experience taking hardware from architecture through bring-up and high-volume production deployment.
Experience working with external hardware vendors and partners — reviewing their designs and holding them to a specification.
Ability to reason about trade-offs across adjacent hardware domains (e.g., interconnect ↔ power ↔ thermal ↔ mechanical) rather than within a single one.

About Supabase
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Supabase is a validated AWS partner building toward a structured multi-year partnership, and we're just getting started. AWS SAs are talking to thousands of customers who need exactly what we build—a full backend platform with Postgres at the core—without the vendor lock-in. This is an opportunity to get Supabase in front of the right SAs and make us the default recommendation for a modern backend.
We’re looking for a Platform Evangelist to join our Partnerships Team and help embed Supabase into the global AWS Solutions Architect community. This role reports directly to the Alliance Lead for the AWS partnership.
You’ll work closely with AWS Solutions Architects , helping us proactively identify customer problems where Supabase is the right solution and closing the gap between partner intent and real customer outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.
What You’ll Be Responsible for

Build deep relationships with AWS Solutions Architects, focusing initially on defined verticals and open-source database migration motions.
Develop and deliver technical workshops, training materials, and enablement content to give AWS SAs the fluency to position Supabase.
Create demos, integration guides, and reference architectures that make Supabase’s fit with AWS services immediately legible.
Partner with AWS SAs on active opportunities, providing technical support to move deals forward and feeding pipeline intelligence back to the alliance.
Technical Support & Enablement
Resolve blockers for AWS SAs working on Supabase implementations to maintain their credibility with customers.
Troubleshoot complex integration scenarios and turn solutions into reusable assets.
Maintain a close feedback loop with Supabase product and engineering teams to ensure technical guidance reflects the latest platform capabilities.
Measure success through co-sell opportunities sourced (ACE pipeline), influenced deals, and SA enablement metrics.
Content Creation & Thought Leadership
Write technical blog posts and case studies that demonstrate real-world Supabase implementations.
Represent Supabase at conferences, meetups, and AWS-sponsored events (e.g., re:Invent and regional summits).
Develop video content and interactive learning experiences to reduce the "time-to-fluency" for AWS SAs.
You Might Be a Good Fit If You
Have 5+ years of experience in technical roles with deep hands-on AWS experience. Previous experience working at AWS or as an AWS partner is required.
Understand AWS SAs' incentives, how they make recommendations, and how the partner ecosystem influences decisions.
Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences, explaining complex concepts with ease.
Have a strong technical foundation in PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern development frameworks like React and Next.js.
Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly to build a playbook from scratch.
Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers.

Fully Remote
We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
Tech Allowance
Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
Annual Off-Sites
Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
Flexible Work
We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
Professional Development
Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it.
Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role.
The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance.

This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations.

The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma.
This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need.

API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract.
System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows.
Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks.
Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews.
Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption.
Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams.
Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging).
Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration.
Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience).
Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required.
Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns.
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management.
Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams.
Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders.
Ability to collaborate with a global team.

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites.

Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS).
Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design.
API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation).
Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL).
Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services.

Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM.
BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems.
AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering).
Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing.
Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing.
AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided.

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data.

Atuar como referência técnica em Inteligência Artificial, acompanhando tendências de mercado e promovendo a evolução contínua das soluções da Sensedia , disseminando conhecimento sobre IA Generativa, Arquitetura Agêntica e arquiteturas de IA, identificando oportunidades de inovação e contribuindo para a melhoria contínua das ofertas, produtos e serviços da empresa.
Atuar como mobilizador e articulador entre áreas internas e parceiros da Sensedia , com o objetivo de potencializar as soluções em desenvolvimento e garantir a melhor entrega de valor aos clientes.
Liderar iniciativas, de ordem técnica ou não, voltadas à melhoria contínua do desempenho da equipe, buscando a excelência das entregas, o desenvolvimento técnico dos profissionais e, consequentemente, a ampliação das vendas, da satisfação dos clientes e das margens do time de Pré-Vendas.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

Atender agendas, em parceria com o time de vendas, para levantamento dos requisitos técnicos e de negócio do cliente.
Apresentar e demonstrar, com clareza, completude e notável domínio técnico, as ofertas de produtos e serviços da Sensedia , que estejam diretamente relacionados ao projeto em discussão, permitindo ao cliente a percepção da afinidade da Sensedia com seu desafio.
Desenhar a solução, contemplando uma proposta técnica clara, eficiente sob o ponto de vista tecnológico, que esteja alinhada com os requisitos técnicos, funcionais e de negócio, ao mesmo tempo que em linha com eventuais limitadores financeiros.
Defender essa proposta junto ao time do cliente, atuando como um consultor especialista, direcionando a solução para a melhor entrega de valor ao cliente, mas tendo a responsabilidade de refinar e reavaliar conforme impedimentos eventualmente apresentados (técnicos, operacionais, financeiros, etc).
Apresentar soluções alternativas mesmo que envolvam componentes técnicos fora do escopo padrão da oferta Sensedia .
Apresentar, de forma autônoma, os resultados das provas de conceito, APIs e novas funcionalidades para o cliente e para o time de produto;
Contribuir ativamente na geração de conteúdos relacionados a oferta da Sensedia , através de artigos, blogposts, webinars, workshops e apresentações em eventos, desta forma disseminando a presença da Sensedia como referência em sua área de atuação;
Contribuir com o desenvolvimento técnico do time através da preparação e compartilhamento de material adequado (treinamentos, documentação, workshops) e capacitação da equipe.
Atuar como influenciador técnico dentro da Sensedia , trazendo demandas e visões de mercado para melhoria dos produtos existentes e/ou construção de novas ofertas;
Liderar a estratégia de respostas para avaliações externas (como Gartner e Forrester) e questionamentos de prospects, tais como RFPs.
Formatar e apresentar propostas de produtos/features, para o time de Product Engineering, e de novos serviços para o time de Consultoria.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

Sólidos conhecimentos em arquitetura de integração com API Management e iPaaS;
Sólidos conhecimentos em arquitetura de inteligência artificial * Domínio em design de APIs e modelos de segurança.
Experiência com soluções utilizando diferentes abordagens: HTTP, REST API, SOAP, JDBC, NoSQL, Event Driven, MCPs, A2A.
Conhecimentos nos principais componentes dos mais relevantes serviços cloud existentes (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Conhecimentos em metodologias de desenvolvimento;
Experiência com arquiteturas em geral como de sistemas e software - especialmente no paradigma de microsserviços e arquitetura agêntica.
Desejável: comprovada experiência em projetos de integração de sistemas utilizando plataformas de AI, APIs, iPaaS ou SOA.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

Conhecimento em Arquitetura Agentica
Conhecimento sobre processos de vendas: Sales Engineering, MEDDIC, SPICED, BANT
Experiencia anterior com pré-vendas técnicas de SaaS para B2B
Conhecimento de plataformas de APIM e/ou iPaaS como Mulesoft, Digibee, Axway, WSO2 ou Kong
Conhecimento de plataformas de AI Gateway como Kong AI Gateway, Databrics, etc

Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment-Tech
Willkommen bei vivenu – dem globalen Vorreiter für Event-Ticketing-Technologie und einem der weltweit schnellst wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen im Live-Entertainment.

Wir revolutionieren Ticketing für internationale Größen wie die Grammys, die Golden Globes, die Stanford University und den Hockenheimring – und machen aus einer einfachen Ticketing-Transaktion einen echten strategischen Wettbewerbsvorteil.

Mit über 65 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung im Rücken ermöglicht unsere Plattform Veranstaltern, ihre Markenpräsenz selbst zu steuern, tiefgreifende Datenanalysen zu nutzen und Ticketing nahtlos in ihre digitale Infrastruktur zu integrieren.
Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen.
Werde Teil unserer Mission – und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.
Als Solution Architect (d/f/m) bei vivenu gehören zu deinen Aufgaben:
Konzeptionierung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen für individuelle integration gaps, wie API-Anbindungen, Single Sign-On (SSO)-Setups und ERP-Systeme, unter optimaler Nutzung der leistungsstarken Plattform-Features von vivenu
Aufbau enger Partnerschaften mit Enterprise-Kunden, um deren bestehende digitale storefronts nahtlos in eine hochmoderne, vollständig auf unseren robusten APIs basierende Headless-Commerce-Architektur zu überführen
Durchführung technischer Workshops mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern auf Kundenseite – von CTOs und IT-Abteilungen bis hin zu externen Digitalagenturen und Ticketing-Managern –, um Anforderungen zu analysieren und komplexe Bedürfnisse in skalierbare Blueprints zu übersetzen
Abstimmung der Kundenerwartungen mit den Plattformkapazitäten von vivenu in einer Funktion als interner Eskalationspunkt für komplexe technische Fragen im Post-Sales; Gewährleistung, dass alle konzipierten Lösungen tragfähig und skalierbar sind sowie eigenständig umgesetzt werden können
Einsatz von Rapid Scripting, KI-Tools und Proof-of-Concepts zur schnellen Validierung von data flows, um diese maßgeschneiderten Lösungen in Whitepaper und globale integration templates zu verwandeln
Schnelle Anpassung an neue Gegebenheiten sowie die Bereitschaft, flexibel in jede Branchen- oder technische Herausforderung einzutauchen, um innovative Plattformlösungen von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben

Warum bei vivenu einsteigen?
Live-Entertainment-Technologie
Spiele eine entscheidende Rolle für globale Marken und gestalte das Fan-Erlebnis neu – von Festivals bis hin zu großen Sport Events. Bei uns bist du Teil des Business of Fun – angetrieben von modernster Technologie, die besondere Momente für Millionen greifbar macht.
Nachhaltiges Wachstum
Wir wachsen nachhaltig auf einer profitablen, von Investoren unterstützten Basis mit echtem Product-Market-Fit. Das bedeutet kontinuierliche Investitionen in unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Produkte und unsere langfristige Vision.
Top-Tier Team
Arbeite mit über 160 engagierten Profis zusammen – darunter Führungskräfte von Google, Slack und Salesforce. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Live-Entertainment-Technologie – Entscheidung für Entscheidung.
Globale DNA
Wir sind ein vielfältiges, leistungsorientiertes Team mit sechs Standorten weltweit. Bei uns zählen Talent und Impact – nicht Hierarchie oder Hintergrund.
Rasantes Wachstum, in jeder Hinsicht
Sifted zählt uns regelmäßig zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Europa. Wir werden angetrieben durch konstantes Lernen, gemeinsame Erfolge und kollektives Wachstum.
Next-Gen-Führungskräfte & Insights
Arbeite Seite an Seite mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe in Tech – von Forbes 30 Under 30-Gründern bis hin zu „Executive of the Year“-Preisträgern. Bei vivenu setzt du neue Standards für die Zukunft der Ticketing-Branche.
vivenu Inklusions-Statement
Bei vivenu glauben wir, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden unseren Erfolg ausmachen – und dass wir mit mutigen, vielfältigen Menschen gewinnen. Die stärksten Teams entstehen durch unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Stimmen. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle befähigt fühlen, sich einzubringen, zu wachsen und zu gedeihen, um die Zukunft des Live-Entertainments weltweit mitzugestalten.

As Salesforce Architect, you will be the technical backbone of Marqeta's Business Systems team, a lean, high-impact group that serves as the internal Salesforce platform team for Go-To-Market (GTM), Product Support, and Legal, Risk & Compliance (LRC). This is a heavily hands-on lead individual contributor role, you will be writing code, configuring the platform, and directly solving hard technical and business problems, not just producing designs for others to build.
We are looking for someone who has genuinely operated as an architect, owning architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and their consequences for at least 2 years, not an engineer aspiring to grow into the title.

You will set the architectural direction for our Salesforce platform, conduct code reviews, lead architecture and design sessions, build and maintain the technical backlog, proactively identify gaps in systems and processes, and independently drive solutions to completion.

You will also be a hands-on builder: configuring, coding, and deploying complex solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and our ongoing migration from CPQ to Revenue Cloud.

You will drive our Agentforce and AI strategy, own integrations with critical systems like Ironclad, Intacct, and the broader GTM toolchain, and play a lead role in ongoing security hardening of the Salesforce org.
Your work will directly support strategic company-wide initiatives, improve customer experience, and increase productivity for internal users across GTM, support, and compliance functions.
We work Flexible First . This role can be performed remotely in the United States, only in one of our National locations, which you can review here .

Lead architecture and design sessions, producing clear design documents, solution options, and tradeoff analyses
Author and maintain coding and design standards for SFDC and ecosystem applications.
Conduct thorough code reviews and enforce engineering best practices, security standards, and declarative-first design principles
Build and maintain the technical backlog—translating platform observations, stakeholder needs, and audit findings into well-scoped engineering work
Proactively identify gaps in system design, data integrity, automation, and integrations; propose and deliver solutions before they become incidents
Conduct regular Org Health Assessments and define a continuous improvement roadmap for platform quality, security, and performance
Own Salesforce release management pipeline, sandbox strategy, source code control, CI/CD tooling and assessment ensuring clean, auditable deployments

Design, build, test, and deploy solutions in an Agile framework using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, REST/SOAP APIs, and platform events
Lead the technical design and implementation of Agentforce and AI-powered automation across GTM, customer support, and compliance workflows
Design and build integrations with internal and external systems, including Ironclad (CLM), Snowflake, and other GTM/RevOps tooling
Define testing strategy, write test scripts, and execute tests to meet quality and coverage standards across releases
Maintain high sprint velocity while upholding code quality and documentation standards

Own hands-on remediation of Salesforce security findings across the full spectrum, session/certificate hardening, sharing model and default access control fixes, data exposure and classification gaps, public link/OAuth and connected app governance, and secure-coding fixes (SOQL injection, XSS, hardcoded credentials, sharing violations) surfaced by code scans
Leverage Salesforce Shield Event Monitoring to capture and analyze login, API, and transaction logs moving from passive log collection to proactive threat detection, anomaly alerts, and audit-ready reporting
Design for appropriate data classification, access controls, and auditability across compliance-critical Salesforce objects

Implement and maintain the org's backup and recovery solution including configuring backup schedules, monitoring job health, and running restore/recovery procedures when needed

Translate complex business requirements from GTM, LRC, and Product Support into well-architected, scalable Salesforce solutions
Communicate technical tradeoffs and architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Lead stakeholder demos and participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives

About MongoDB
MongoDB는 변화를 위해 만들어졌습니다. 우리는 고객과 구성원들이 시장의 속도에 맞춰 혁신할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 우리는 AI 시대를 위한 데이터 플랫폼을 새롭게 정의함으로써, 빌더들이 소프트웨어를 통해 산업을 창조하고, 변화시키며, 혁신할 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다. 시장에서 가장 폭넓게 제공되며 전 세계에 분산된 MongoDB의 통합 데이터 플랫폼은 조직이 레거시 워크로드를 현대화하고, 혁신을 수용하며, AI의 잠재력을 최대한 발휘할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 클라우드 네이티브 플랫폼인 MongoDB Atlas는 전 세계에 분산된 유일한 멀티클라우드 데이터 플랫폼으로, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure 전반에서 사용할 수 있습니다.
전 세계에 오피스를 두고 있는 MongoDB는 67,000개 이상의 고객을 보유하고 있으며, 여기에는 포춘 100대 기업의 75%와 AI 네이티브 스타트업이 포함됩니다. 이들은 가장 중요한 애플리케이션을 MongoDB로 운영하고 있으며, 우리는 소프트웨어의 다음 시대를 이끌고 있습니다.
MongoDB에서 우리의 나침반은 Leadership Commitment 입니다. 이는 우리가 어떻게, 그리고 왜 의사결정을 내리는지, 서로를 위해 어떻게 행동하는지, 그리고 어떻게 함께 성공하는지를 이끄는 기준입니다. 이것이 바로 MongoDB를 MongoDB답게 만드는 요소입니다.
우리는 모든 구성원의 개인적 성장과 비즈니스 영향력을 높이기 위해, 모든 사람에게 지지와 풍요로움을 제공하는 문화를 만드는 데 헌신하고 있습니다. 직원 커뮤니티(affinity groups)에서부터 난임 치료 지원, 그리고 넉넉한 부모 휴가 제도 에 이르기까지, 우리는 구성원의 웰빙을 중요하게 여기며, 그들의 직업적·개인적 여정을 모든 단계에서 지원합니다. MongoDB에서 일하는 것이 어떤 경험인지 더 알아보고, 세상에 변화를 만드는 우리의 여정에 함께해 주세요!

You will collaborate with technical and business stakeholders, provide architectural guidance, and help partners accelerate adoption of Microsoft technologies.

This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep technical and partner engagement skills, and build expertise across Microsoft's cloud, AI, and security solutions.

Microsoft offers a flexible work environment, allowing employees to work from home part of the time while collaborating regularly with their teams and partners.
As a **Partner Solution Architect**, you will gather partner insights and leverage these insights to design solution architectures, provide technical expertise, develop and validate Microsoft solutions, and help partners achieve business outcomes through successful technology adoption.

You will act as a trusted technical advisor, supporting solution design, readiness, and the adoption of new Microsoft technologies. This opportunity will allow you to leverage your knowledge of Microsoft products, services, and value propositions in partner conversations while identifying opportunities to drive partner growth and customer success.
Microsoft-s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. * Sie gestalten Lösungsarchitekturen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 und der Microsoft Power Platform.

* Sie setzen Lösungen selbst auf Dynamics 365 und der Power Platform um.
* Sie entwickeln Workflows und Automatisierungen mit den Möglichkeiten der Power Platform.
* Sie definieren und steuern Datenflüsse zwischen verschiedenen Systemen.
* Sie konzipieren und realisieren Integrationen und Erweiterungen.
* Bei komplexeren Anforderungen können auch Azure Functions zum Einsatz kommen.
* Sie entwickeln die Plattform strukturell weiter und etablieren Standards sowie wiederverwendbare Lösungen.
* Sie arbeiten eng mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.
## Ihr Profil ##
* Sie verfügen über fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit **Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM**.
* Sie bringen sehr gute Kenntnisse der **Microsoft Power Platform** mit und haben entsprechende Lösungen bereits selbst umgesetzt.
* Sie haben Erfahrung im **Solution Design oder in der Solution Architecture** und können fachliche Anforderungen in technisch konsistente Lösungen übersetzen.
* Sie verfügen über ein gutes Verständnis von **Systemarchitekturen, Datenstrukturen und Datenmodellen**.
* Sie verstehen das Zusammenspiel von Systemen sowie die damit verbundenen **Integrationen und Datenflüsse**.
* Sie arbeiten gerne konzeptionell und setzen Lösungen gleichzeitig auch selbst technisch um.
* Erfahrung mit Workflows, Low Code Automatisierung und Integrationslösungen ist von Vorteil.
* Kenntnisse im Azure Umfeld, insbesondere mit **Azure Functions**, sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.
* Sie kommunizieren klar und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und technischen Stakeholdern zusammen.
## Was Sie erwartet ##
Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle innerhalb eines spezialisierten Plattform Teams und erhalten die Möglichkeit, die CRM und Power Platform Landschaft aktiv mitzugestalten.
Dabei bewegen Sie sich nicht in einer reinen Architekturrolle. Sie entwickeln Lösungsansätze, treffen strukturelle Designentscheidungen und begleiten diese bis in die konkrete Umsetzung.
Sie arbeiten innerhalb eines definierten technischen Rahmens und verfügen gleichzeitig über Gestaltungsspielraum bei der fachlichen und strukturellen Ausarbeitung der Lösungen.
Das Unternehmen bietet ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit grundsätzlich drei Präsenztagen am Standort in der Region Frauenfeld und zwei Homeoffice Tagen. Projektabhängig können fixe oder zusätzliche Präsenztage erforderlich sein.

Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning
At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.
This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.
Senior AI Architect
o9 is restructuring its technology organization around purpose-built engineering groups, upgrading to modern tech stacks and AI-first software to drive a streamlined, R&D-focused powerhouse. As part of this transformation, we are building a world-class core AI function from the ground up to serve as the foundational intelligence layer across all product engineering domains.
This is a premier technical individual contributor (IC) role with the structural weight, seniority, and impact of an SVP. We are looking for someone who has lived on the bleeding edge of artificial intelligence at industry-defining technology companies—someone who can take a bold architectural vision and turn it into production reality.
The Scale of Opportunity
o9 is on a trajectory that very few enterprise software companies ever reach. We are building toward a global footprint of 10,000 enterprise customers—each running complex, mission-critical supply chain and business planning operations on our platform. At that scale, AI is not a buzzword or a feature add-on; it is our core strategic differentiator.
Our ambition goes further: o9 is pursuing a neurosymbolic AI architecture—combining the reasoning power of large language models with the formal rigor of symbolic computation and constraint-based planning. The platform that emerges will be unlike anything currently available in enterprise software. The person who steps into this role will literally write the playbook and construct the foundation for this architecture.
To understand the core philosophy behind what you will be building, review the framework established by our EVP of AI, Ashwin Rao:
Read the fundamental thesis onThe Neurosymbolic Imperative for Enterprise AI.
Explore the practical application of this paradigm inDavos Insights: Turning VUCA into Value with Neuro-Symbolic AI.
The north star for our customers is the APEX operating model—a state of integrated, autonomous, AI-driven planning that eliminates the friction between insight and action across the enterprise. This role is the architectural engine that makes APEX possible.
What you’ll own
You are single-handedly accountable for o9’s core AI architectural integrity and our neurosymbolic roadmap. Your mandate covers the following pillars:
Neurosymbolic Platform Architecture: Architect the hybrid systems that seamlessly blend LLMs with deterministic, constraint-based planning engines, translating high-level conceptual vision into concrete, scalable code and system designs.
AI Strategy & Governance: Set the technical standard for how AI is implemented across the entire engineering organization, ensuring framework consistency, performance optimization, and enterprise-grade reliability.
Cutting-Edge R&D Evaluation: Continually evaluate, benchmark, and integrate state-of-the-art models, agentic workflows, and vector infrastructures into the core o9 platform.
Technical Truth: Serve as the ultimate technical court of appeal for complex AI engineering roadblocks, deep triage, and algorithmic limitations.
What you’ll build
The foundational architecture for o9’s neurosymbolic AI engine, successfully bridging the gap between connectionist (neural networks) and symbolic AI.
The framework and blueprints that allow hundreds of product engineers to safely, predictably, and continuously ship AI-driven capabilities.
The next-generation intelligence layer enabling 10,000 enterprise customers to run autonomous business planning at an order of magnitude more scale than we serve today.
What you’ll have
Experience: 15+ years of deep engineering background, with a distinguished track record of building and transforming advanced software platforms.
Tier-1 Tech Background: Significant engineering tenure at a premier technology organization (e.g., FAANG, Uber, Slack, Snowflake, Stripe, Datadog, or comparable).
Proven AI Leadership: Clear track record as a principal or lead architect on production-grade AI/ML systems at massive scale.
Neurosymbolic Aptitude: Deep, hands-on familiarity with both large language models (generative AI, embeddings, vector databases) and traditional, structured, constraint-based symbolic computation.
High Autonomy: Direct, fast, and exceptionally comfortable operating without bureaucratic approval chains. You move quickly, own your architectural decisions, and hold yourself accountable for outcomes.

About Plane
Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.
Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.
Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.
Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.
Humans and agents
We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.
Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.
This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once.

You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up.

You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call.

Own the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work.
Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist.
Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one.
Define the migration path when a customer moves off two or three existing tools at once, including what data does not survive the move and saying so up front.
Work daily with sales on live deals and with engineering when a customer's requirements expose a real gap in the product, carrying that gap back as a specific, scoped request rather than a vague one.
Answer the same security questionnaire in a slightly different format for the fourth time this month, because every regulated buyer's procurement process is its own small bureaucracy and none of them read each other's paperwork.

You have designed and defended a technical architecture to a skeptical buyer , and you can walk us through one deal where the customer's own security or infrastructure team changed your design.
You understand self-hosted and on-premises deployment beyond a docker-compose file , including networking, SSO and identity federation, and what changes when a customer runs the software instead of you.
You can read a security questionnaire or compliance requirement and translate it into an actual deployment decision , not a reassurance.
You are comfortable being the technical voice on a sales call , including the parts where the answer is no or not yet.
You write technical documentation a customer's own engineers will actually follow , because you will not be in the room when they run it.

You have worked pre-sales or post-sales in a solutions architecture, sales engineering, or technical account management role selling to regulated industries.
You have contributed to Plane, run it self-hosted, or maintained another open project people rely on.
You have shipped or supported deployments into banking, defense, healthcare, or air-gapped environments specifically.
You have opinions about how AI agents should be permissioned and audited in an enterprise environment, and can defend them.
Tech
Backend : Python/Django, Golang, Node.js, Postgres, Redis
Messaging : RabbitMQ, Kafka
Infrastructure : AWS, Kubernetes, Rancher, self-hosted deployment via Docker and Helm

Why Plane?
Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead.
The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both.
The constraints make you better. Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer.
The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production. We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role.

Du stellst sicher, dass Einzellösungen sinnvoll ineinandergreifen und langfristig wartbar bleiben.

Du definierst und steuerst, wie Daten zwischen Systemen fliessen, und stellst sicher, dass diese konsistent und nachvollziehbar verarbeitet werden \- bei Bedarf auch unter Nutzung von Integrationen und Erweiterungen.
Du entwickelst die Plattform strukturell weiter \- mit Fokus auf Standards, Wiederverwendbarkeit und nachhaltige Architekturentscheidungen.
